candidate_relations.reason: Moyamoya is a different chronic vasculopathy and does not capture MIS-C with COVID-associated acute ischemic stroke.
MIS-C with myocarditis names the correct inflammatory syndrome but substitutes unsupported myocarditis (normal troponin/echo) for the required acute ischemic stroke.
SIRS is a broad inflammatory parent and omits MIS-C and COVID-associated ischemic stroke.
AHLE is a different fulminant demyelinating disease, not MIS-C with ischemic stroke.
COVID-associated MIS-C with neurological involvement is compatible but does not specify the required acute ischemic stroke.
COVID-associated encephalitis conflicts with multifocal arterial stenoses and infarct-pattern hypodensities; CSF was negative for SARS-CoV-2.
Primary CNS lymphoma is a different neoplastic diagnosis, not MIS-C with stroke.
Kawasaki disease is a related mucocutaneous inflammatory parent of MIS-C but omits COVID-associated acute ischemic stroke; echo showed no coronary dilatation.
Vasculitis captures intracranial stenoses but omits MIS-C and the COVID-associated ischemic-stroke composite.
Pediatric multisystem inflammatory syndrome with COVID-related acute ischemic stroke is an alias of MIS-C with COVID-19-associated acute ischemic stroke.
Neuroinflammatory syndrome is a broad parent and lacks MIS-C plus acute ischemic stroke.
Herpes simplex encephalitis is a different infectious encephalitis, not MIS-C with ischemic stroke.
Acute ischemic stroke is a required component but omits MIS-C and the COVID-19 association.
ADEM is a different demyelinating syndrome, not MIS-C with large-vessel ischemic stroke.
MIS-C is the correct inflammatory parent but omits the required COVID-associated acute ischemic stroke.
Multifocal vascular neuropathy is a peripheral-nerve diagnosis, not cerebral arterial ischemic stroke.
Multifocal vasculitic neuropathy is a different PNS entity, not intracranial arterial stroke.
Cerebrovascular disease is a parent of the infarcts but omits MIS-C and COVID-19 association.
Rasmussen encephalitis is a different chronic hemispheric epilepsy syndrome.
Toxoplasmosis is a different opportunistic infection and is not supported.
